facts.note: Nine o'clock bell, watches shown; hers exact, Félix 20 min behind, Girard 4 min behind, doctor 2 min ahead. The transcript adds only a habit ('as he did every year'), which is excluded.
After dinner in the atelier beside the master; at the temple's ten the regulator agreed with the bell exactly.
Sent downstairs when the regulator showed twenty past ten; regulator was running then and he was well.
Compared her watch with Rosa's clock in the kitchen; Rosa's clock exactly fifteen minutes fast.
Piano began at twelve minutes to eleven and stopped at one minute past eleven, both by the kitchen clock. The remark about which pieces were played is music, which is excluded.
Went straight down to the kitchen and stayed with Rosa from arrival until after the temple struck eleven.
